---
title: "The L.A. Times 101 Restaurant Tracker"
output:
  html_document:
    includes:
      in_header: header/header.html
      after_body: include_footer.html
lang: "en"
---

How often does the L.A. Times 101 list make room for a first-timer? Every edition since 2013 is here. Pick a year to see who made their debut, who came back, and who stayed on.

<style>
.la101 { --debut: #9e351f; --return: #ecc37e; --repeat: #245b53; --other: #dce3e0; }
.la101 .edition-chart { display: grid; gap: 5px; margin: 12px 0 22px; }
.la101 .edition-button {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) 10rem; gap: 8px;
  align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; width: 100%; text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid #cbd4d0; border-radius: 5px; background: #fff; color: #1b302b;
}

}

.la101 .geo-matrix button {
  width: 100%; min-width: 3.25rem; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid #cbd4d0;
  border-radius: 4px; color: #15352e;
  background: hsl(161, 37%, var(--geo-lightness, 98%));
}
.la101 .geo-matrix button[aria-pressed="true"] { border: 2px solid #164a40; font-weight: 700; }
</style>

## How I counted

I compared all 101 published entries in each edition with the complete history up to that year. An entry is a **first appearance** if it has no earlier match, a **comeback** if its latest match was more than a year earlier, and a **previous edition** pick if it appeared the year before.

I matched spelling changes, moves and relaunches of the same restaurant. A separately reviewed branch can debut on its own, as Badmaash Venice did in 2026. A grouped entry takes up one slot and can establish an appearance for its co-featured restaurants. For example, the 2025 Mercado La Paloma entry keeps Holbox and Komal in the running going into 2026. Mentions in broader market write-ups and the separate Hall of Fame are excluded. The 2020 edition used nine slots for profiles of people and organizations, shown as other honorees.

The [Times’ 2018 roundup](https://www.latimes.com/food/dailydish/la-fo-re-new-101-list-20181205-story.html) highlighted 31 debuts. This tracker counts 28 new slots that year. Bar Amá and Somni appeared in shared slots with previously listed restaurants, and Jon & Vinny’s had already appeared in 2015.

Sources are the [L.A. Times archive of annual lists](https://www.latimes.com/food/story/2024-12-03/101-best-los-angeles-restaurants-since-2013-jonathan-gold-bill-addison) and the original edition linked for each year.

```{r la101-data, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
edition_json <- paste(readLines("data/la_times_101.json", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
cat('<script type="application/json" id="la101-data">\n',
    gsub("<", "\\u003c", edition_json, fixed = TRUE), "\n</script>\n", sep = "")
geo_lines <- readLines("data/la_times_101_geography.json", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
cat('<script type="application/json" id="la101-geo-data">\n',
    gsub("<", "\\u003c", paste(geo_lines, collapse = "\n"), fixed = TRUE), "\n</script>\n", sep = "")
```

<script>
(() => {
  const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("la101-data").textContent);
  const years = Object.keys(data).reverse();
  const chart = document.getElementById("la101-chart");
  const year = document.getElementById("la101-year");
  const status = document.getElementById("la101-status");
  const query = document.getElementById("la101-query");
  const summary = document.getElementById("la101-summary");
  const source = document.getElementById("la101-source");
  const entries = document.getElementById("la101-entries");
  const historyQuery = document.getElementById("la101-history-query");
  const historySummary = document.getElementById("la101-history-summary");
  const historyEntries = document.getElementById("la101-history-entries");

  function element(tag, text) {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  }

  function searchKey(text) {
    return text.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase();
  }

  const statusRank = { "First appearance": 0, "Comeback": 1, "Previous edition": 2, "Other": 3 };

  // Sort on one column; blanks always go last. Ties fall back to `tiebreak`.
  function sortRows(rows, state, getters, tiebreak) {
    const get = getters[state.key];
    return rows.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      const x = get(a);
      const y = get(b);
      if (x == null || y == null) {
        if (x != null || y != null) return x == null ? 1 : -1;
      } else if (x !== y) {
        const order = typeof x === "string" ? x.localeCompare(y, "en") : x - y;
        if (order) return state.dir * order;
      }
      return tiebreak(a, b);
    });
  }

  // Turn every th[data-sort] into a toggle button that updates `state` and re-renders.
  function makeSortable(table, state, rerender) {
    const heads = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("th[data-sort]"));
    const mark = () => {
      for (const th of heads) {
        th.setAttribute("aria-sort", th.dataset.sort !== state.key ? "none" :
          state.dir > 0 ? "ascending" : "descending");
      }
    };
    for (const th of heads) {
      const button = element("button", th.textContent);
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "sort-button";
      th.classList.add("sortable");
      th.replaceChildren(button);
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const firstDir = th.dataset.firstDir === "desc" ? -1 : 1;
        state.dir = state.key === th.dataset.sort ? -state.dir : firstDir;
        state.key = th.dataset.sort;
        mark();
        rerender();
      });
    }
    mark();
  }

  function rowNumber(n) {
    const td = element("td", n);
    td.className = "rownum";
    return td;
  }

  function setupGeography() {
    const geography = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("la101-geo-data").textContent);
    const matrix = document.getElementById("la101-geo-matrix");
    const geoYear = document.getElementById("la101-geo-year");
    const geoRegion = document.getElementById("la101-geo-region");
    const geoSummary = document.getElementById("la101-geo-summary");
    const geoEntries = document.getElementById("la101-geo-entries");
    const buttons = [];
    const geoSort = { key: "slots", dir: -1 };
    const geoGetters = { area: ([place]) => place, slots: ([, names]) => names.length };
    const byYear = Object.fromEntries(years.map(edition => {
      const areas = new Map();
      for (const [name, place] of Object.entries(geography.editions[edition] || {})) {
        if (!areas.has(place)) areas.set(place, []);
        areas.get(place).push(name);
      }
      return [edition, areas];
    }));

    function renderGeography() {
      const places = byYear[geoYear.value];
      const region = geoRegion.value;
      const filtered = Array.from(places).filter(([place]) => !region || geography.regions[region].includes(place));
      const total = filtered.reduce((sum, [, names]) => sum + names.length, 0);
      geoSummary.textContent = `${geoYear.value} · ${region || "All regions"} · ${total} of ${data[geoYear.value].rows.length} slots`;
      geoEntries.replaceChildren();
      const sorted = sortRows(filtered, geoSort, geoGetters, ([a, aNames], [b, bNames]) =>
        bNames.length - aNames.length || a.localeCompare(b, "en"));
      sorted.forEach(([place, names], index) => {
        const tr = element("tr");
        const label = element("th", place);
        label.scope = "row";
        tr.append(rowNumber(index + 1), label, element("td", names.length),
          element("td", names.join(", ")));
        geoEntries.append(tr);
      });
      for (const button of buttons) {
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", button.dataset.year === geoYear.value && button.dataset.region === region);
      }
    }

    const header = element("tr");
    for (const label of ["Region", ...years]) {
      const th = element("th", label);
      th.scope = "col";
      header.append(th);
    }
    matrix.tHead.append(header);
    for (const edition of years) {
      const option = element("option", edition);
      option.value = edition;
      geoYear.append(option);
    }

    for (const [region, places] of Object.entries(geography.regions)) {
      const option = element("option", region);
      option.value = region;
      geoRegion.append(option);
      const counts = years.map(edition =>
        places.reduce((sum, place) => sum + (byYear[edition].get(place)?.length || 0), 0)
      );
      const peak = Math.max(1, ...counts);
      const tr = element("tr");
      const label = element("th", region);
      label.scope = "row";
      tr.append(label);
      years.forEach((edition, index) => {
        const count = counts[index];
        const button = element("button", count);
        button.type = "button";
        button.dataset.year = edition;
        button.dataset.region = region;
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${region}, ${edition}, ${count} slots`);
        button.style.setProperty("--geo-lightness", `${98 - 30 * count / peak}%`);
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          geoYear.value = edition;
          geoRegion.value = region;
          renderGeography();
        });
        buttons.push(button);
        const td = element("td");
        td.append(button);
        tr.append(td);
      });
      matrix.tBodies[0].append(tr);
    }
    geoYear.addEventListener("change", renderGeography);
    geoRegion.addEventListener("change", renderGeography);
    makeSortable(geoEntries.closest("table"), geoSort, renderGeography);
    renderGeography();
  }

  function buildHistory() {
    const restaurants = new Map();
    const standaloneByYear = new Map();
    for (const [edition, { rows }] of Object.entries(data)) {
      const standalone = new Map();
      standaloneByYear.set(Number(edition), standalone);
      for (const row of rows) {
        if (row.status === "Other") continue;
        const names = (row.note || row.name).split(" / ");
        const isStandalone = names.length === 1;
        // Follow prior names for the same restaurant without merging the members of a shared slot.
        const previousKey = isStandalone && standaloneByYear.get(row.previous)?.get(row.match);
        for (const name of names) {
          const key = previousKey || searchKey(name).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
          if (!restaurants.has(key)) {
            restaurants.set(key, { name, aliases: new Set(), editions: new Set() });
          }
          const restaurant = restaurants.get(key);
          restaurant.editions.add(edition);
          restaurant.aliases.add(name);
          restaurant.aliases.add(row.name);
          if (isStandalone) {
            restaurant.name = name;
            standalone.set(row.name, key);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(restaurants.values()).sort((a, b) =>
      b.editions.size - a.editions.size || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "en")
    );
  }

  const history = buildHistory();
  const historySort = { key: "appearances", dir: -1 };
  const historyGetters = {
    name: restaurant => restaurant.name,
    appearances: restaurant => restaurant.editions.size,
    latest: restaurant => Math.max(...Array.from(restaurant.editions, Number))
  };
  const historyTiebreak = (a, b) =>
    b.editions.size - a.editions.size || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "en");

  function renderHistory() {
    const needle = searchKey(historyQuery.value.trim());
    const visible = history.filter(restaurant =>
      Array.from(restaurant.aliases).some(name => searchKey(name).includes(needle))
    );
    const rows = document.createDocumentFragment();
    sortRows(visible, historySort, historyGetters, historyTiebreak).forEach((restaurant, index) => {
      const tr = element("tr");
      const label = element("th", restaurant.name);
      label.scope = "row";
      tr.append(rowNumber(index + 1), label,
        element("td", `${restaurant.editions.size} / ${years.length}`),
        element("td", Array.from(restaurant.editions).join(", ")));
      rows.append(tr);
    });
    historyEntries.replaceChildren(rows);
    historySummary.textContent = `Showing ${visible.length} of ${history.length} entries.`;
  }

  const editionSort = { key: "name", dir: 1 };

  function renderEdition() {
    const { source: url, rows, counts } = data[year.value];
    const needle = searchKey(query.value.trim());
    const matches = rows.filter(row =>
      (!status.value || row.status === status.value) &&
      searchKey([row.name, row.note, row.match].join(" ")).includes(needle)
    );
    // Names keep their published (alphabetical) order unless another column is chosen.
    const published = (a, b) => rows.indexOf(a) - rows.indexOf(b);
    const visible = sortRows(matches, editionSort, {
      name: row => rows.indexOf(row),
      rank: row => row.rank,
      status: row => statusRank[row.status],
      first: row => row.first,
      previous: row => row.previous
    }, published);
    source.href = url;
    const [debut, comeback, previous, other] = counts;
    const otherText = other ? `, ${other} other honoree slots` : "";
    summary.textContent = `${year.value} · ${debut} first appearances, ${comeback} comebacks, ${previous} from the previous edition${otherText}. Showing ${visible.length} of ${rows.length} entries.`;
    entries.replaceChildren();
    visible.forEach((row, index) => {
      const tr = element("tr");
      const label = element("th", row.name);
      label.scope = "row";
      const rank = element("td", row.rank ?? "—");
      rank.className = "rownum";
      tr.append(rowNumber(index + 1), rank, label,
        element("td", row.status === "Other" ? "Other honoree" : row.status),
        element("td", row.first ?? "—"), element("td", row.previous ?? "—"));
      if (row.match && row.match !== row.name) {
        tr.lastElementChild.append(element("small", ` · ${row.match}`));
      }
      entries.append(tr);
    });
    for (const button of chart.children) {
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", button.dataset.year === year.value);
    }
  }

  for (const edition of years) {
    const isTransition = edition === "2018";
    const label = isTransition ? "2018*" : edition;
    const option = element("option", label);
    option.value = edition;
    year.append(option);
    const { counts } = data[edition];
    const [debut, comeback, previous, other] = counts;
    const button = element("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "edition-button";
    button.dataset.year = edition;
    if (isTransition) button.setAttribute("aria-describedby", "la101-2018-note");
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${edition}, ${debut} first appearances, ${comeback} comebacks, ${previous} from the previous edition, ${other} other honoree slots`);
    const bar = element("span");
    bar.className = "edition-bar";
    bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    ["debut", "return", "repeat", "other"].forEach((className, index) => {
      const segment = element("span");
      segment.className = className;
      segment.style.flexGrow = counts[index];
      bar.append(segment);
    });
    button.append(element("strong", label), bar, element("span", `${debut} new · ${comeback} back`));
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      year.value = edition;
      renderEdition();
    });
    chart.append(button);
  }
  year.addEventListener("change", renderEdition);
  status.addEventListener("change", renderEdition);
  query.addEventListener("input", renderEdition);
  historyQuery.addEventListener("input", renderHistory);
  makeSortable(historyEntries.closest("table"), historySort, renderHistory);
  makeSortable(entries.closest("table"), editionSort, renderEdition);
  renderHistory();
  renderEdition();
  setupGeography();
})();
</script>
